text:
kim: kicking off a canary sweep for model v2.2 in 30m. plan = 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 15m/15m/15m windows, geo sweep NA -> EU. looking for owners for smoke checks and who will trigger each ramp. rollback threshold: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m. pinging @mira for smoke scripts and @leo for deploy

dante: i can own NA smoke checks. i'll validate traffic, basic prompts, and embedding latency. i'll be on standby during ramps. :white_check_mark:

mira: happy to run EU smoke and metrics validation. i'll run the standard smoke script and check the eval set against baseline. smoke command i'll run:
```
# quick health + sample gen
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"v2.2","prompt":"Summarize the email below"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
```
Expect: no >5% token errors, median latency < 180ms. i'll post results in thread.

sam: who is actually triggering the ramps? do we want manual ramps or automated schedule?

leo: i'll trigger each ramp manually via deploy-bot, watching the dashboards between steps. plan: start 09:15 PT, then +15m +15m. i'll wait for sign-off from dante/mira after each step before proceeding.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary start at 2026-03-17T16:15:00Z (09:15 PT). Steps queued: 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.infra/canary-runbook. Will post step confirmations.

mira: rollback readiness: i've prepped rollback tag `v2.1.9-locked` and a canary-rollback playbook. if errors > threshold, run:
```
# rollback command
deploy-bot rollback --tag v2.1.9-locked --scope canary
```
also re: data, no schema changes in this release so safe to rollback without migration concerns.

dante: NA smoke checklist (short):
- run 10 sample prompts from smoke set
- check /metrics latency p50/p95
- ensure embedding deltas within 1.5%
- validate no new 5xx on infra side
I'll paste a quick pass/fail after each ramp.

kim: perfect. leo pls wait for both dante + mira ok before moving to next step. i'll update the release issue and tag @eng-oncall in case we need immediate assistance. if all green at 20% after 30m, we proceed to broad rollout. :rocket:

sam: noted. i'll keep an eye on cost page for token spikes and alert if abnormal.

leo: good. will start at 09:15 PT and log each step here. thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Step 1 (1%) deployed at 2026-03-17T16:15:00Z — awaiting manual approval for next step.
